summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) building real-time computer vision and perception systems for robotics: 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, and synthetic data generation for training perception models in Unreal-based simulation. Experienced in C++ and Python across camera-guided robotic manipulation, ray-traced rendering, and applying generative models (Gemini, fine-tuned transformers) inside live engineering pipelines.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Developed a custom image-stitching pipeline using homography estimation for high-resolution 3D surface reconstruction, achieving a PSNR of 65 against baseline stitching.
Designed a custom wavelet bank combined with optimized homography stitching to suppress noise, improving PSNR to 86.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling, achieving ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction of metal surfaces.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept using AI-based real-time chroma keying without a green screen; produced full claims documentation and BOM.
Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove with Raspberry Pi and Bluetooth, resolving sensor jitter through software calibration.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU across data recipes and augmentation pipelines for 3D volumetric inputs.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom object-detection dataset (1,133 images); trained YOLOv8n achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation, exported to ONNX and TFLite.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated synthetic data generation pipelines in CARLA (Unreal Engine based simulator) with zero manual annotation, producing ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames used to train YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and UFLD, validated in Town02 with zero collisions.

projects.name: Parallel Ray Tracer with MPI Task Scheduling
bullets: Implemented and benchmarked four parallel work distribution strategies for ray-traced rendering of 5000x5000 pixel scenes using MPI, achieving up to 30x speedup with static strip partitioning across 55 processes.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system integrating Gemini intent classification, TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup: 56.7 to 10.9 ms) for visual servoing, and dual ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping.
Resolved 11 integration failures; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency, driving five servos via two-link inverse kinematics in C++.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
